name: open_time
description: Candle open time

name: open
description: First trade price in the candle

name: high
description: Highest price in the candle

name: low
description: Lowest price in the candle

name: close
description: Last trade price (known only when the candle closes)

name: volume
description: Traded volume in the candle

name: close_time
description: Candle close time

name: quote_volume
description: Traded value in the candle

name: trades
description: Number of trades in the candle

name: taker_buy_base
description: Volume bought by aggressive (taker) buyers

name: taker_buy_quote
description: Value bought by takers

name: time
description: Candle open time as a timestamp

name: ret_1
description: Close-to-close return over 1 candle

name: ret_4
description: Return over 4 candles (1 hour)

name: ret_16
description: Return over 16 candles (4 hours)

name: ret_96
description: Return over 96 candles (1 day)

name: vol_16
description: Std of 1-candle returns over the last 16 candles

name: vol_96
description: Std of 1-candle returns over the last 96 candles

name: atr_14
description: 14-candle average true range divided by close

name: rsi_14
description: Relative strength index, 14 candles

name: macd_hist
description: MACD(12,26) minus its 9-candle signal line, divided by close

name: bb_width
description: Bollinger band width (4 x std over 20 candles) relative to the 20-candle mean

name: bb_pos
description: Close minus 20-candle mean, in units of 2 x std

name: vol_z
description: Volume vs its 96-candle mean and std

name: taker_ratio
description: Taker-buy volume divided by total volume (buying pressure)

name: trades_z
description: Trade count vs its 96-candle mean and std

name: dist_vwap
description: Close divided by 96-candle VWAP, minus 1

name: hour_sin
description: Sine of UTC time of day (cyclical)

name: hour_cos
description: Cosine of UTC time of day (cyclical)

name: dow
description: UTC day of week, 0 = Monday

name: fwd
description: TARGET SOURCE: close HORIZON candles ahead divided by current close, minus 1 (training only)

name: y
description: TARGET: 0 = Down, 1 = Neutral (inside +/-THRESH), 2 = Up (training only)
